name.baseName: Printed wiring board, through-hole, lead-free surface, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The functional unit represents 1 m2 of a 2-layer FR-4 PWB, lead-free surface finished (mixture of various finishing methods), with soldermask, for through-hole mount applications, without mounted components. It is designed to be used in industry electronics and simple ICT applications. Process data are taken from environmental reports of 2 German PWB producers, plus from literature. The described PWB has a square weight of 3.08 kg/m2.; UUID: d9ef7a6e-018c-34d6-b171-25f760f71707

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: This module is based on information from European producers that are seen as representative for the global situation.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Dataset comprises the following steps of PWB production: substrate preparation, imaging, exposure, etching, sandwiching, via opening, desmearing, activation and accelaration steps as well as via filling, second imaging, exposure, copper plating, cleaning, oxidification, dry vacuum lamination, micro etching, surface finishing.

# Included processes
The module covers the assembly of a PWB prepared for surface mounting of components. In this dataset (raw) materials, infrastructure, energy consumption, emissions to air and water and waste amounts from the production of 1 m2 of board are taken into account. Not included into this dataset is the mounting of the PWB.
